name: OmaNosey
author: Wizwam
description: Puts Nosey Bugger on the Omarchy screensaver: a fullscreen QR honeypot so anyone who peeks at an unattended screen can leave a note.

barWidget.description: Idle screensaver shows a scannable Nosey QR. Preview, toggle idle, set a public URL.

schema.label: Use as idle screensaver
schema.description: When on, idle launches Nosey instead of the ASCII / Kingdom Age screensaver. Off restores the previous launcher.

schema.label: Public Nosey URL
schema.description: If this host serves ?unattended, the screensaver kiosks it so phone scans work off-LAN. Otherwise OmaNosey uses the local server and a LAN QR.

schema.label: Local server port
schema.description: Local honeypot bind port. QR uses your LAN address so people in the room can scan.
